desc: Leonard, in a red shirt, while sitting on the couch, changes his position and crosses both legs.
Sheldon, in a green shirt, makes a set of air quotations with his fingers while sitting at the couch.
Sheldon, in a green shirt, turns toward Leonard and makes Hulk arms while sitting on the couch.
Leonard, in purple hoodie, and Sheldon simultaneously lift their bags over their shoulders.
Sheldon, in a green shirt, and Leonard, in a red shirt, walk down a flight of stairs and stop in front of a bike in the hallway.
Howard, in a plaid orange shirt, takes his phone out of his pocket and puts it to his ear at the comic store.
Leonard is laying along the entire couch, then bends his knees freeing up one end of the couch where Sheldon sits down with a magazine in his hands.
Sheldon sits down on the couch with a comic book in his hands, next to lying on the sofa Leonard, in a red shirt.
Leonard, in a red shirt, reaches from the sofa for his glasses on the coffee table and puts them on.
Sheldon, in a green shirt, sets down his comic book on the arm of the sofa.
Sheldon starts to close his laptop a bit before opening it again while sitting on the couch.
Sheldon, in a green shirt, darts up from the couch and rushes down three flights of stairs shouting for Leonard.
Leonard puts his hand on the doorknob and holds it while talking with Sheldon, in a green shirt.
Howard closes his front door behind him, at night, as he is talking to Leonard, in a blue shirt.
Sheldon takes number 2 sign off of his desk and shows it to Leonard.
Sheldon, in an orange shirt, leaves Leonard's side to hide close to the wall in the hallway.
A woman in a blue top, uses a cloth napkin to dab each of her armpits at the restaurant.
A woman in a blue top, shakes Leonard's hand and leans to him closer as she sits beside him at the restaurant table.
A woman in a blue top,  slaps Leonard on the front of his shoulder as she laughs at the restaurant.
Leonard says something and a woman in a blue top, pretends to hit him and laughs hysterically, at the restaurant.
Sheldon, in an orange shirt, walks down the apartment stairs and jumps off the last step.
A shot of Amy, in a purple jacket, standing outside the glass doors of Sheldon's apartment building.
A woman in a blue top, turns and points behind her as she is leaving the restaurant dining room.
Someone in a red puffer jacket and a red hat, walks slowly down the stairs and Amy stares at him.
Amy, in a purple jacket, puts her laptop bag over her shoulder and stands up from the steps.
Sheldon, in a red puffer jacket and a red hat, takes off a pair of funny novelty glasses while talking to Amy.
A woman in a blue top, and Bernadette sit down at the table with Leonard and Howard.
A woman in a blue top, picks up a glass of white wine, winks at Leonard and takes a drink.
Sheldon, in a purple shirt, is speaking to Amy's mother through Skype on his laptop while she turns her head at him, smiling.
Amy and Sheldon, in a purple shirt, sit on the couch video chatting with Mrs. Fowler, who waves slowly with a shocked expression.
Sheldon, in a purple shirt, closes a red laptop that's sitting on Amy's lap, while sitting on a couch.
